construction.walls: 215 mm solid brick masonry with washable mineral plaster internally; matching red-brown house brick externally
construction.base: Concrete slab and masonry plinth; foundations to suit ground and nearby trees
construction.roof: Steel supports and steel deck, tapered mineral-wool insulation, non-combustible ceiling lining, limited waterproof roof covering and metal fascia/gutter
construction.use: Detached single-storey garden workshop/tool room; no sleeping accommodation
construction.status: Architectural concept. Confirm full assembly, roof structure, surveyed levels and exemption with building control before construction; masonry appearance alone is not a fire-performance specification.
